title: The Music from the Harbor Posts
youtube_title: The Music from the Harbor Posts | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Golda finds a harbor posts humming when the wind came sideways. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Golda shows Gita how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
